shots.say: You took the hand. Four bricks up. Then the statue wakes.
It wants its hand back. It rips twelve bricks off you before you get away. Ninety-two.
The hall ends at two dark corridors. A voice in the wall offers you the way out, for a price.
In Jujutsu Kaisen, that's a binding vow. Break one, and nobody knows what the punishment will be.
The voice is kind. It sounds exactly like you.
A: pay it six bricks for the true way, and owe it a debt it won't name. Or B: refuse, lose ten bricks in the dark, and owe nothing. Comment A or B. Part 3 follows the vote.
